dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, linear pale edges visible along the outer webs of the folded primaries and secondaries against darker feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Clear linear boundary where the dark, uniform crown/nape plumage transitions into the scaled pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive pale distal fringing on the dorsal feathers creates a repetitive scalloped appearance across the mantle and scapulars.
